# HEALTH 2.0 全旅程 API

<!-- Generated by tools/sync-implementation-contract.cjs; do not edit. -->

当前业务约束见 [全旅程需求](../feature/journey-2.0.md) 和 [四层同步基线](implementation-baseline.md)。所有请求字段为 snake_case，每个接口独立 Controller / DTO；响应为 JourneyResponse 或分页/统计 DTO。

| 请求 DTO | 方法与路径 | body 字段 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ActJourneyCaseRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/case_action | `id`, `version`, `request_id`, `case_id`, `action`, `evidence` |
| OpenJourneyCaseRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/case_open | `id`, `version`, `request_id`, `kind`, `summary`, `due_at`, `evidence` |
| JourneyCaseQueryRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/cases_query | `page`, `size`, `patient_id`, `kind`, `status`, `overdue` |
| CreateJourneyRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/create | `patient_id`, `kind`, `entry_phase`, `source_system`, `event_key`, `event_at`, `identity_evidence`, `handoff_evidence`, `request_id` |
| JourneyDetailRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/detail | `id` |
| AcceptJourneyHandoffRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/handoff_accept | `id`, `version`, `request_id`, `evidence` |
| NoJourneyRevisitRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/no_revisit | `id`, `version`, `request_id`, `reason`, `evidence` |
| DraftJourneyPlanRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/plan_draft | `id`, `version`, `request_id`, `plan_text`, `record_id`, `template_id`, `nodes`, `evidence` |
| ReviewJourneyPlanRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/plan_review | `id`, `version`, `request_id`, `plan_id`, `approved`, `review_note`, `evidence` |
| JourneyQueryRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/query | `page`, `size`, `patient_id`, `kind`, `status` |
| JourneyStatusRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/status | `id`, `version`, `request_id`, `action`, `evidence` |
| CompleteJourneyStepRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/step | `id`, `version`, `request_id`, `step_code`, `evidence`, `occurred_at`, `appointment_id`, `record_id`, `outcome`, `satisfaction_status`, `satisfaction_score`, `feedback` |
| JourneySummaryRequest | POST /boruikang/admin/journeys/summary | `patient_id` |

变更携带 id、version、request_id 与依据；create 使用来源事件去重。相同请求键、操作者和内容重试返回已保存响应，变化内容或操作者拒绝。计划 nodes 使用 PlanNodeDto（seq、stage、offset_days、task_type、title、priority、checklist）。

| 当前步骤 | 可执行人员 |
| --- | --- |
| HANDOFF / 接入与服务交接 | OWNER |
| CONSULT / 咨询与预约协助 | OPERATIONS |
| ARRIVAL / 实际到院核验 | OPERATIONS |
| IN_HOSPITAL / 院内检查与流程协助 | OPERATIONS |
| CLINICAL / 门诊结束与医嘱核对 | DOCTOR |
| PLAN / 诊后个案计划审核 | DOCTOR |
| FOLLOWUP / 随访执行与医生反馈 | OPERATIONS |
| CLOSE / 复诊结果与服务结案 | OPERATIONS |

出院路径：HANDOFF → IN_HOSPITAL → CLINICAL → DISCHARGE_HANDOFF → PLAN → FOLLOWUP → CLOSE。OWNER 为当前负责人本人；DOCTOR 为当前责任医生本人；OPERATIONS 为按医院和患者权限范围授权的主管、护士、运营。平台账号不得访问患者旅程。

CLOSE 仅接受 VERIFIED / NONE，退出走 status EXIT；满意度 RATED 才携带 1–5 分，其他结果不携带分值。病历、任务、预约复用已有 API；当前计划随访完成并经医生查收、所有问题闭环才可结案。
